title: Composer plugin manifest
description: Schema for Claude Code plugin manifests under plugin/<plugin-name>/plugin.json. Locked by ADR 0002 M0.2.

name.description: Plugin slug — lowercase kebab-case. Matches the parent directory name.

description.description: One-paragraph human-readable summary surfaced in plugin lists.

claudeCodeVersion.description: Claude Code version range this plugin supports. npm semver range syntax (>=4.6, ^4.6.0, etc).

requires.description: Peer dependencies — npm package names of MCP servers or other plugins this plugin assumes.

settings.description: Hook wiring merged into the consumer project's .claude/settings.json on install.

skills.description: Paths (relative to plugin root) of SKILL.md files to register on install.

agents.description: Paths (relative to plugin root) of subagent .md files to register on install.

commands.description: Paths (relative to plugin root) of slash-command .md files to register on install.
